text: This video replays Leah's illustrative loan through every ten-year stretch of U.S. interest rates since January nineteen fifty-four. "Worth it" gets one plain meaning here: how often the variable loan cost more in total interest than the nine percent fixed loan, and how much more at worst. Then the replay moves the head start, from a variable rate three points under the fixed rate to one one point over it, to see where that history changes. By the end there's a line that any real offer can be held up against, including yours. This is history, not a forecast.
